svg.text: LFM / A little help, right when you need it.
PROPOSED DESIGN · App, floating assistant, voice and widget · 12 November 2026
Warm ivory. Soft lilac. Clear actions. No hardware jargon in everyday screens.
A fresh perspective, whenever you need it.
How do I make a busy day
Start with a little breathing room.
Choose one thing that matters most.
Give it twenty quiet minutes before
you open the rest of your day.
A question, an idea, or a fresh start.
Go on. What’s on your mind?
A small way to reset my day?
Step away from your screen, get
some water, and choose just one
The app is a place to return to.
The floating panel is a short, useful interruption.
The widget is the quickest way in.
Concept only. Includes planned features such as Read aloud. No app changes applied in this planning pass.
Mic → Send → Stop; never competing actions.
Compact first. Expand when you want more.
